_comment: In-repo held-out-style conceptual tasks. Queries share no identifier
tokens with the expected labels. The fixture lives under
tests/corpus/conceptual-disjoint/. This is not conceptual-v1 and may
not be used to retire that suite.

tasks.query: How does the tool record how sure it is that a conclusion holds?
What keeps a speed claim from being silently tied to one machine?
Which contract lets a new lens of inspection be registered and applied uniformly?
Which routine assembles a way to multiply matrices using fewer scalar products than the obvious triple loop?
What single structure wires the discovery stages together in order?
Which module implements the GraphQL subscription transport?
